   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Nov 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kyle Huntingdon_, Nov 8, 2026, 1/5: "I was enjoying the app but it started crashing. They had me load an old version of the app but when I cancelled on the old version I still got billed the full amount today and cannot find a support function to get this fixed. I liked it when it worked but it's turning into a scam."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _RitaPeets_, Nov 9, 2026, 2/5: "I’m giving 2 stars because I did like the app. I never purchased any challenges prior to now in addition to the app subscription until yesterday. I only did so because they were showing videos of challenges on Instagram. In the advertisement it appears that you are watching specific videos daily for 30 days for $21.99. But all I got was 4 pdf files with meal plans, and some other pointless content that I don’t care about. Literally I only joined a challenge for the videos. If I wanted some pdf files to read I could’ve got ChatGPT or Gemini to do that for free, which is probably what they used in the first place. I did hear back from support telling me that my workouts are in the trainer message and to check again. I rechecked and all I see are very short pointless instructions with meal plans saying “recommendations: walking, stretching, yoga” if that’s what they are referring to as my “workouts” then that’s a total rip off. If in fact there are videos to watch and what I’m experiencing is a simple tech issue, then I’ll revise my review and resubscribe. I have cancelled and will just consider my $21.99 gone forever. You can get me once but not twice. If this is what you’re actually selling then your Instagram adds are extremely misleading. Why would I pay $21.99 in addition to the subscription when the subscription offers videos but the challenges don’t? That makes no sense ugh."
